name: Rodinia k-means device/host iteration
description: K-means iteration: transpose features, assign nearest centroids on device, recompute centroids on host.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: feature_transpose + find_membership kernels verbatim; host recomputes centroids (double accumulation) between launches; fixed 4 iterations, centroids seeded with first points. From the HeCBench raw clone (not yet a collection snapshot).
notes: Fills the multi-kernel-pipelines gap with the classic Rodinia clustering pipeline.
